g.text: panel = ComparisonPanel (in UsedCarGUI / WorkspaceUI); form = PreparationForm; worker = SwingWorker<ComparisonEvaluation,Void>; compareCmd = CompareVehiclesCommand.
facade = UsedCarApplicationFacade; session = EvaluationSession; agent = UsedCarAgent; tools = ToolManager; checker = DataQualityChecker; costTool = CostCalculatorTool.
knowledgeTool = VehicleKnowledgeTool; repository = VehicleKnowledgeRepository; constraintTool = ConstraintCheckerTool; factory = EvaluationStrategyFactory; policy = EvaluationStrategy.
Repository lazily loads bundled vehicle-knowledge.csv. No match → VehicleKnowledge.noData(); failure → explicit unavailable limitation. No invented reliability research.
Both sides share p and a; CONFLICT / UNKNOWN findings remain. Constraint-tool failure sets constraintsAvailable=false and blocks AI. No body-type rule.
collectEvidence returns RiskEvidence(v, profile, m, k, f, c, guidance, limits, constraintsAvailable, Year.now(clock).getValue()).
comparisonEvidence adds shared-assumption / cost-failure limits and returns an updated RiskEvidence. Repeat for B after A returns.
Then agent creates new ComparisonEvidence(aEvidence, bEvidence, assumptions) → B1. Optional cost/knowledge gaps alone do not force the sufficiency gate.
createStrategy(p) [default / automatic; manual mode reuses selected policy]
No assumptions → c=null; record explicit limitation. Cost-tool RuntimeException → c=null, costFailed=true.
Missing consumption / tax / allowances → unavailable components; no guessed values.
Java computes litres, annual fuel cost, tax and first-year estimate using the common scenario.
Example only: fictional Corolla / Mazda3 + supplied assumptions → CAD 18707.00 / 19911.25.
B − A = CAD 1204.25; not a fixed runtime result or a purchase verdict.
opt [a != null] — same CostAssumptions for A and B
sd A3 — comparisonEvidence(v, p, a): exactly two sequential calls, A then B; no F08 invocation
ref B1 → B2 → B3: ComparisonEvaluation return, version check, then GUI / CLI display
compare(first, second, p, a) [distinct IDs required]
version = contextVersion.get(); first = currentVehicle(); second = comparisonVehicle().
Missing A / B → IllegalStateException (GUI also checks before scheduling).
compareWithEvidence(first, second) reads preferences() and session.getCostAssumptions().
These are separate reads, not one atomic context snapshot; no unsaved form values.
sd A2 — Compare saved vehicles; CLI compare uses the same command
Session rejects b.id == A.id; B remains in its own slot. A / preferences / assumptions are unchanged.
Cancel edits / reload saved B: clear form, reload facade.comparisonVehicle(), refresh summaries; no save.
Invalid save: GUI error; prior records preserved. Refresh saved summaries reads A / B / common assumptions.
CLI comparison-set: :keep / :cancel; yes confirms. comparison-show displays saved A/B and assumptions.
[invalid] throw; no save, previous records retained
[valid] saved B ID or new UUID → Vehicle
sd A1 — save B independently; A already saved via F01 / confirmed F02
